title: Detailed gift bag
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- background glow-free, dark screen implied -->
  <!-- bag body -->
  <path d="M26 38 L74 38 L78 90 Q78 94 74 94 L26 94 Q22 94 22 90 Z" fill="#e8556d" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- bag shine left -->
  <path d="M28 42 L30 88 Q30 90 32 90 L36 90 L34 42 Z" fill="#f57a8e" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- bag bottom fold -->
  <path d="M22 86 L78 86 L78 90 Q78 94 74 94 L26 94 Q22 94 22 90 Z" fill="#c2405a"/>
  <path d="M22 86 L78 86" stroke="#ff9fb0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- inner opening (dark lit purple) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="24" ry="5.5" fill="#4a2b6b"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="24" ry="5.5" fill="none" stroke="#ffb3c4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- handles -->
  <path d="M34 38 C34 18 66 18 66 38" fill="none" stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M34 38 C34 18 66 18 66 38" fill="none" stroke="#ffe9a8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- front decorative panel -->
  <rect x="34" y="50" width="32" height="30" rx="3" fill="#ffd166" stroke="#ffe9a8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- bow/ribbon on panel -->
  <path d="M50 52 L50 78" stroke="#e8556d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <path d="M50 52 C42 46 36 52 42 58 C46 60 50 56 50 52 Z" fill="#e8556d" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M50 52 C58 46 64 52 58 58 C54 60 50 56 50 52 Z" fill="#e8556d" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- small heart on panel -->
  <path d="M50 68 C47 64 42 65 42 69 C42 73 50 77 50 77 C50 77 58 73 58 69 C58 65 53 64 50 68 Z" fill="#e8556d" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- side stripes for detail -->
  <rect x="27" y="44" width="3" height="40" fill="#ffb3c4" opacity="0.6"/>
  <rect x="70" y="44" width="3" height="40" fill="#ffb3c4" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- tissue paper peeking out -->
  <path d="M36 36 C40 30 44 34 46 36" fill="#7fd8c4" stroke="#a8f0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M54 36 C58 30 62 32 64 36" fill="#7fd8c4" stroke="#a8f0e0" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
